description: Create a booking, appointment, meeting, hold, or any scheduled event on a calendar. Once created, this event blocks the agent's availability during that time and appears in availability queries. Use status="hold" with hold_expires_at to tentatively reserve a slot that auto-releases on TTL.

all_day.description: Whether this is an all-day event. All-day events are stored as whole days: start_time becomes midnight UTC of the date written in start_time (in its own offset), and end_time midnight UTC after the last day the end touches (a T23:59:59 end covers that whole day), at least one day. Availability treats an all-day event as busy for those whole UTC days; for a local-day block, use a timed event.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID to add the event to

end_time.description: End time (ISO 8601). For an all-day event, midnight after the last day (exclusive), e.g. "2026-07-05T00:00:00Z" for a one-day event.

hold_expires_at.description: Required when status="hold". ISO 8601 timestamp 30s-15min in the future. Auto-releases the hold when reached.

hold_priority.description: Only valid with status="hold". Higher-priority overlapping holds pre-empt lower-priority ones. Defaults to 0.

recurrence_rule.description: Make this a recurring series (RFC 5545 RRULE subset, no "RRULE:" prefix), e.g. "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=12". Supports FREQ=DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY, INTERVAL, COUNT (max 730) or UNTIL, BYDAY (weekly list or monthly ordinal like 2TU/-1FR), BYMONTHDAY (1-28 or -1). start_time must match the rule pattern (in timezone when set, else UTC). Not allowed with status="hold". Free plan: 1 recurring series, must end within 90 days.

reminders.description: Reminder offsets in minutes before start_time (e.g. [10, 1440]). Each fires an event.reminder webhook and shows as an alarm in the iCal feed. Omit or null to inherit the calendar default (then the system default of 10 min); [] for no reminders.

start_time.description: Start time (ISO 8601). For an all-day event, the first day at midnight, e.g. "2026-07-04T00:00:00Z".

status.description: Event status. "hold" creates a tentative reservation that auto-expires at hold_expires_at. Defaults to "confirmed".

timezone.description: IANA time zone the recurring series repeats in, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". A weekly 16:00 then stays 16:00 local across daylight-saving changes; BYDAY and a date-only UNTIL are read in this zone. Omit for UTC.

name: create_event
